reader.requirement: A statement in a program directly or indirectly contained in the program that declares a global data-name, file-name or report-name may reference it without describing it again, under the X.1.3.8 scope rules.

edition-consulted.switches: hands session.Edition to the unit's DataBinder (EditionContext): diagnostics wording and edition-gated clause checks; the inheritance seed (InheritStep.Seed) and InheritContainerGlobalData take no edition
below 2002 a data-description clause operand (ODO, KEY, RENAMES) takes no implicit qualifiers; not on the procedure-division reference path these rules govern

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|Cobol1985|Cobol85|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior' over InheritStep.cs, SymbolTable/SymbolTable.cs, SymbolTable.Reports.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.Declarations.cs, SymbolTable.Files.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, ReportScope.cs and DataBinder.cs: TryResolve, TryResolveUnqualified, NearestDeclaring, NearestDeclaringData, NearestDeclaringConditions, NearerConditionNameHides, InheritGlobalSubtree and InheritReport consult no edition; the only hits are message citations (Edition.Edition.Cite), SumCounterOperand85 and ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1047 covers data items; the probes add a global FD and its record, a global report, an ODO record, two-level indirect containment and the refusals

probes.printed: I X=MID / I Y=INY / I YG=OUY / I XG=OUX / I Z=OUZ / I C=FALSE / I CCV=TRUE / J X=MID Z=OUZ / J C=FALSE / 3 X=OUX / 3 C=TRUE / O REC=IREC1 / O Y=NEW N=4 V=4AB**
probes.expected: B's own Y (GR3a); unqualified X and C in SCOPEI/SCOPEJ the middle program's (GR3b1), in SCOPE3 the outer's; Y OF G, X OF G, C OF CV and Z the one object qualification identifies (GR1, GR2); the global FD and its record written from the contained program; the ODO record and reference modification of a global group altered from the contained program

probes.printed: COBOL1639 at 12 'IG' not defined (outer naming a contained program's GLOBAL item); 22 'NG' not defined (non-global item of the container); 23 'X' does not uniquely identify (two GLOBAL X in the container); 30 'IG' not defined (sibling's GLOBAL item)
probes.expected: all four refused: the set is B's names plus the containers' GLOBAL names only (GR1); two objects in A with none in B is not unique (GR3b1); a program cannot reference names declared in a program it contains (X.1.3.8.2)

contained program reads unqualified LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER OF R1 of the container's GLOBAL report (its only visible report), alters PAGE-COUNTER and sum counter T OF LN1, and the container sees the same registers

probes.printed: COBOL2404 on 77 W77 GLOBAL and 05 SUBG GLOBAL (cites §1985:X.4.3.3 SR4); COBOL0900 on LINKAGE 01 LK GLOBAL: 'requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)'
probes.expected: §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1: GLOBAL only on 01 entries of the File or Working-Storage Section, FDs and RDs; the later editions' LINKAGE GLOBAL refused at 85
middle program's GLOBAL TOT is nearer for unqualified TOT (GR3b1); TOT OF CFG OF R1 the outer's sum counter (GR1/GR2)

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR2  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:X.4.6.4 GR2" "may reference that name without describing it again")

reader.notes: Directly (SCOPE3, RPTI) and indirectly (SCOPEI, SCOPEJ, SC3I) contained programs reference, write and read the container's GLOBAL items, FD record and report without describing them; a non-global item, a contained program's global item and a sibling's global item are refused. At 85 GLOBAL on 77, on a subordinate entry and in LINKAGE is refused. The qualified-sum-counter gap is recorded on 1985-GR-X.1.3.8.2-1.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985 operand classes of 'global name' the reader did not try. glb1.cob (container: non-GLOBAL FD F with 01 FR GLOBAL. 05 FR1; WORKING-STORAGE 01 A2 and 01 B2 REDEFINES A2 GLOBAL with subordinates B21, B22 and level-88 B22-ZZ; contained GB1I moves 'QQQ' TO FR1, 'ZZ' TO B22, tests B22-ZZ, displays B2): --std 85 EXIT 0, 'I ZZ / I B2=AAZZ / O A2=AAZZ' and gb1.dat 'QQQ': a GLOBAL 01 record of a non-GLOBAL FD (§1985:X.4.6.3 SR1 admits GLOBAL on a File Section 01 entry), the subject of a GLOBAL REDEFINES entry, its subordinate data-names and its condition-name are all referenced from the contained program without being described again. glb2.cob (container: 01 A1 GLOBAL with 01 B1 REDEFINES A1 not GLOBAL; 01 A2 not GLOBAL with 01 B2 REDEFINES A2 GLOBAL; contained program references B1 and A2): EXIT 65, COBOL1639 at (17,28) 'B1' and (18,28) 'A2' not defined: neither is a global name (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR3: only the subject of the REDEFINES has the attribute), so neither is admitted. The cross-class hiding failure found on 1985-GR-X.1.3.8.2-3 (an own data-name or report-name not hiding the container's GLOBAL report-name or data-name) is the scope rule that GR2's '(See page X-4, Scope of Names.)' defers to, booked there. No probe overturned. Citations: OK §1985:X.4.6.4 GR2 ('may reference that name without describing it again'); OK §1985:X.4.6.4 GR3 ('it is only the subject of that REDEFINES clause which possesses the global attribute'); OK §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1 ('data description entries whose level-number is 01 in the File Section or the Working-Storage Section').
